goal: Use a taught spelling pattern to attempt a word, check its pronunciation and connect it with meaning.

articulation.label: car
articulation.alt: car: /k/ → /ɑ/ → /r/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/ɑ/: Low back tongue; jaw open.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: park
articulation.alt: park: /p/ → /ɑ/ → /r/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɑ/: Low back tongue; jaw open.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bird
articulation.alt: bird: /b/ → /ɝ/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: turn
articulation.alt: turn: /t/ → /ɝ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
